Keep the tray icon visible beside the clock. Amber means a choice is pending; gray means waiting, snoozed or dismissed; blue means dark mode.
Left-click the tray icon to open Settings; right-click for theme, snooze and reminder actions. Ctrl + Alt + Shift + D also switches themes. Themes never change automatically, including in the morning.
Settings lets you choose a time window, snooze delay and language. Language changes are previews until you save; closing without saving restores the previous language. Follow Windows uses the system display language at startup, with English as fallback.
NightCue runs locally, without network requests. Settings and state are stored beside the executable. Before uninstalling or moving it, disable sign-in startup, save, and exit from the tray menu. Then delete or move the folder.
Open the hidden-icons arrow beside the clock and drag NightCue onto the taskbar. You can also enable NightCue in Windows taskbar settings (Windows 11: other system tray icons; Windows 10: select which icons appear on the taskbar). Windows controls icon visibility; NightCue cannot pin itself. A gold sun offers light mode after the end time. It never switches themes automatically.
